tasks.title: Environment selector on WorkdayConfig + WORKDAY_* conf settings
tasks.parallelism_notes: Foundation task. Modifies config.py, which TASK-2137 and TASK-2138 both build on. Spec mandates per-spec isolation, so it runs first and sequentially in the shared worktree.

tasks.title: SOAP endpoint host rewrite on WorkdayService (bind_service override)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Needs the env-aware workday_url from TASK-2136. Also edits service.py, a convergence point shared with TASK-2138's config surface and the FEAT-230/232 handler registrations — must not be merged concurrently.

tasks.title: WorkdayRestClient — REST /ccx/api client on aiohttp
tasks.parallelism_notes: Creates a brand-new file (rest.py) so it is file-disjoint from Modules 3-6, but it consumes the env selector from TASK-2136. Largest single deliverable; the aiohttp rewrite is the main behavioural risk in the feature.

tasks.title: Cost-centre organisation-hierarchy enrichment
tasks.parallelism_notes: Technically file-disjoint (cost_centers.py + cost_center_parsers.py only) and could run in its own worktree, but the spec chose per-spec isolation so every hunk decision builds on the previous one.

tasks.title: Clock-event write surface — delete, location/cost-centre override, GPS
tasks.parallelism_notes: Technically file-disjoint (clock_event.py + put_time_clock_events.py). Kept sequential per the spec's per-spec isolation decision.

tasks.title: Custom-report JSON parsing path (_parse_json_to_entries)
tasks.parallelism_notes: Technically file-disjoint (custom_report.py only). Kept sequential per the spec's per-spec isolation decision.

tasks.title: Two latent bug fixes — TimeBlock Pydantic defaults + Organization_Type_ID form
tasks.parallelism_notes: Small and file-disjoint (time_block.py + organizations.py), but both changes alter existing behaviour, so they are isolated into their own task with regression tests that must fail before the fix.

tasks.title: Residual parser & model hunks (curated sweep)
tasks.parallelism_notes: No hard dependency, but MUST run late: it regenerates the normalised diff so gaps already closed by TASK-2136..2142 drop out of its worklist. Touches many files across parsers/models/handlers, so it would conflict with almost any concurrent task.

tasks.title: workday pyproject extra + manual smoke script
tasks.parallelism_notes: Closing task. The smoke script exercises the whole ported surface, so it needs Modules 1-5 complete. Spec's Module 7 declares this dependency explicitly.
